profile.headline: Building software on a mission
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm a full stack software engineer with some data science experience focused on creating software that improves lives. For the last few years, I have concentrated on the digital health startup space. I'm also interested in the future of software development, cloud native computing, and software ethics, especially issues related to data privacy and security. I enjoy solving problems, developing products, and doing requirements engineering. I graduated June 2020 with a BS in Software Engineering from CalPoly SLO. 
My other passion, besides my work, is playing harpsichord. I have played piano since I was young and have studied harpsichord seriously for the past couple years. I also serve on the board of a local baroque orchestra, Sinfonia Spirituosa. Sinfonia is directed by my harpsichord teacher, Dr. Lorna Peters.

Languages/Technologies:
- Proficient: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pandas, scikit-learn), Java, HTML/CSS (with SCSS), PostgreSQL
- Some exposure:  Node/Express, MySQL, C, C++ / C#, MIPS Assembly, PHP, ActionScript
- Architectures/Patterns: Restful APIs, CRUD, MVC, Serverless
- Proficiency with OS's: Windows, Ubuntu/Debian
- Version control: Git/Github
- Cloud Tools/Platforms: GCP, AWS, Docker, Cloud Native + CI/CD
- Other Dev Tools: Jupyter, Eclipse, Maven, Tomcat, Nexus, Travis CI, JIRA, Asana, Jenkins, SonarCloud, VS/VS Code, Postman

Soft Skills/Processes:
- Agile
- API First Development
- Test Driven Development
- Software Development Lifecycle
- Clear communication
- Team player
- Quick learner

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Stack: React/Typescript/Python(FastAPI)/Postgres/ECS/Mirth/Medplum

As the first software engineering hire for Rad AI’s Continuity product, I architected and implemented an application to process radiology reports and track incidental findings, from product inception to launch at multiple major US healthcare networks, which resulted in hundreds of patient lives saved and a $1M+ per year net ROI per customer. Continuity is live and processing thousands of reports daily!

Led backend and API development, including HL7 interfaces. Designed and implemented LLM and generative AI model serving and data processing pipelines in Metaflow, web application microservices, data structures, and a Graphql API layer.

Additionally, collaborated directly with customers, implemented cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform),
and developed our front end application (React).


Rad AI's Continuity provides a central application for care coordination based on radiology reports to ensure all incidental findings are tracked and appropriate follow ups are ordered. This improves patient health outcomes as well as reducing health system liability for missed findings. Rad AI's first product, Omni, generates impressions in radiology reports. Omni integrates directly into voice reporting software (such as Powerscribe or Fluency) and generates individualized impressions automatically with 0 clicks using advance AI technology. Omni improves radiologist's workflow by saving them from re-dictating findings into the impression section, reducing mental fatigue and time taken per report.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Stack: Angular/Python(FastAPI,SQLAlchemy)/PostgreSQL/GCP/Kotlin/Swift

Project lead and fullstack software Engineer (Remote)
Based on an early prototype, architected and developed a scalable, HIPAA compliant web application to manage patient, hospital staff, and assessment data. It facilitates automated psychiatric assessments and documentation of treatment. I also built integrations with, and modifications of, existing native mobile apps for iOS and Android.
I was a hands-on leader of a three person software team reporting to HealMed CEO and CTO

positions.title: Co-Founder, CEO
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States
positions.description:
Stack: Typescript/ReactNative/Python/PostgreSQL/GCP

Grove is a professional communication platform and referral management tool suite for mental health professionals and services. Our secure web and mobile software connects professionals across all license types and allows them to create a professional profile, search our live directory, join groups with their colleagues, send and receive referrals. It is our mission to increase access to and quality of mental health care, one innovation at a time.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As part of the ARES team, programmed on a large scale web application to manage cargo shipping and logistics. Performed in a technical capacity (new feature development and bug fixing/maintenance), as well as meeting with customers, interfacing with other internal teams, planning, and presenting on progress. The team followed Agile principles with monthly sprints and weekly meetings. 

My main focus was the core application consisting of an Actionscript front-end connected to a Java and PostgreSQL/Oracle back-end. I also worked on various side projects as the need arose. This included C# / C++ windows embedded handheld development.

Worked full-time during the summers, continuing part-time during the school year.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
From Dec. 2015 to April 2016, my work focused on Javascript implementation of UI elements in NCLab's Karel course. I also built a simple webview Android application to use the Hour of Code course (hoc.nclab.com).
In the summer of 2015, I worked on various web development tasks including modifying forms in the WordPress plugin and started integration of the Smarty PHP template engine into the site (nclab.com).

volunteerExperiences.description:
Sinfonia Spirituosa is a baroque chamber orchestra based in Sacramento, California focused on historically informed performance on period instruments. In addition to presenting brilliant concerts, Sinfonia also runs a significant mentorship program for music students in high school, university, and early career professionals. You can read more about Sinfonia at sinfoniaspirituosa.org

Sinfonia Spirituosa is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit. As a member of the board since the 2022 fall season, I have helped further Sinfonia's educational mission by managing online ticket sales, supporting concert logistics, and advising in a strategic capacity with regards to fundraising, contracting, and other areas.
